evidence_items.explanation: Gopher's within-family tests found improved TruthfulQA multiple-choice accuracy with increasing size, including alternative evaluation setups. This contradicts a general absence of truthfulness gains, although answer selection does not directly measure the truthfulness of freely generated prose.

unresolved_gaps: No directly matched size-controlled measurement of perceived authoritativeness was established.
The cited studies do not supply a common aggregate measure of truthfulness across ordinary writing tasks.
Generated-answer and multiple-choice results cannot be treated as identical measurements.
